title: 14 January 1963: Live: Civic Hall, Ellesmere Port
content:
700 people packed in to the Civic Hall in Ellesmere Port to see The Beatles on this day – a sell-out for the venue.

This was The Beatles’ only booking in Ellesmere Port. Although a large industrial town on Merseyside, and just 19 miles from Liverpool, they didn’t play there on any other occasion.
